ai_analyses_companies.source: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ticker) FROM ai_analysis WHERE is_current=1 (data/moat.db)

ai_spend_analysis_stage.source: SUM(cost_estimate) over analysis_attempts, all outcomes — real dollars spent even on a validation_failed attempt (data/moat.db)

ai_spend_committee_pilot.source: manual — Sprint 5 committee pilot (21/69 companies, of a $3 cap); the committee stage computes cost_estimate per call but never persists it (committee_verdicts has no cost column), so this figure can't be recomputed from data/moat.db. Update by hand from a real run's logged spend and revise as_of. See docs/sprints/sprint-5-plan.md.

screen_passed.source: SUM(passed_screen) over the latest quality_scores run (data/moat.db)

screen_total.source: latest quality_scores run, same query as the dashboard's `latest_run` (data/moat.db)

universe_companies.source: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companies WHERE is_active=1 (data/moat.db)
